caption: A clear plastic container with rounded corners rests on a white circular surface, holding a single irregular chunk of white crystalline material on a ribbed base. A translucent grayish lobe sits at the chunk's lower right, a few dark specks dot its surface, and small white droplets cling to the base beside it. The mass remains static, its outline unchanged with no visible growth or deformation. The lower-right lobe persists exactly as it appears initially. The container stays fixed against the disc, with only minor apparent shifts of the seat ellipse and background edges consistent with small handheld camera drift. No splitting, rotation, or disappearance of the chunk is visible.
